'''Arbu trees''' were thorny [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that grew on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]]. The smallest villages on the planet were surrounded by rings of arbu trees, which protected their residents from predatory [[Species/Legends|creatures]] such as [[skree-skater]]s.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The arbu tree was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
